![Venkata](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Faccount-images%2F01K3N9CS35FE83YZJ3DQB4K8VD.png&w=3840&q=75)Venkata

HubSpot is a leading all-in-one CRM platform that unifies sales, marketing, and customer service tools to help businesses manage their customer relationships and grow more effectively. SurveySparrow’s native integration with HubSpot enables teams to sync survey responses directly into HubSpot records and trigger surveys based on CRM events without manual intervention.

This helps revenue and customer experience teams act on real-time feedback, close the loop with customers, and build more personalized workflows.

Some interesting use cases include:

- Automatically creating or updating HubSpot contacts or deals when a new survey response comes in.
- Triggering post-purchase NPS or satisfaction surveys when a deal stage changes in HubSpot
- Enriching HubSpot contact profiles with qualitative insights from support or onboarding surveys

In this article, we’ll walk you through setting up the integration and configuring its core capabilities, specifically:

- [Setting up the HubSpot integration](https://surveysparrow-support.sparrowdesk.com/hc/en/articles/7079079627165-Integrating-HubSpot-with-SurveySparrow#hdr_01KKCHXN62BW1EWY0X9B53X7ZX)
- [Mapping survey responses to HubSpot fields](https://surveysparrow-support.sparrowdesk.com/hc/en/articles/7079079627165-Integrating-HubSpot-with-SurveySparrow#hdr_01KKTZ4T9QVC62SJ30ZWSY6NSZ)
- [Creating automated survey triggers](https://surveysparrow-support.sparrowdesk.com/hc/en/articles/7079079627165-Integrating-HubSpot-with-SurveySparrow#hdr_01KKTZBYNTSAP9T6VR2H467C5V)
- [Importing HubSpot contacts into SurveySparrow](https://surveysparrow-support.sparrowdesk.com/hc/en/articles/7079079627165-Integrating-HubSpot-with-SurveySparrow#hdr_01KKTZJJ12RS9NR5GWDZ8E5BXH)
- [Disconnecting HubSpot from SurveySparrow](https://surveysparrow-support.sparrowdesk.com/hc/en/articles/7079079627165-Integrating-HubSpot-with-SurveySparrow#hdr_01KKTZNZ9H103TABVCTF7EF0Y7)

## **Setting up the HubSpot integration** Copy

1\. Inside your SurveySparrow account, click on the Settings icon.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTYNFYHZQ7T77077W9C4P9P.png&w=3840&q=75)

2\. In the account settings section, scroll down till you see the **Apps and Integrations** option, then click on it.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTYNFKZ4RBQ0YA1WT87CTWK.png&w=3840&q=75)

3\. Search for HubSpot using the search box, then click on the toggle.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTYNFS8W9AZGD0E5EXPPCR5.png&w=3840&q=75)

4\. Once enabled, you’ll be redirected to the below page. Click **Sign in to your HubSpot account**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01K6AER32SARGS3DPF32HTFC77.png&w=3840&q=75)

5\. Proceed with your HubSpot credentials to complete the integration.

_**Note:**_ _The HubSpot integration has been revamped with a new UI and support for additional objects when creating triggers and mappings. Even if you have already connected your account to HubSpot already, you will need to reconnect in order to use these new objects. If you have already connected your integration to HubSpot previously, you might now see a banner prompting you to reconnect._

![GG.png](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKV01KZD7R5RNNJ4YYHWABC2.png&w=3840&q=75)If any responses come in while reconnecting to HubSpot, they will not be captured in your existing mappings, so it is advised to do this at a time when survey responses are not expected.

## **Mapping survey responses to HubSpot fields** Copy

1. Open the survey whose responses you want to map, then click on the **Integrate/Configure** tab.![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4W3S2AD2P2BRETTNMGQ0.png&w=3840&q=75)

2\. In the Integrations section, search for the HubSpot integration and click on the toggle next to it.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4WDAXB25Z3M3Y3GYVZG9.png&w=3840&q=75)

3\. Open the HubSpot integration within the survey whose responses you want to map, then click **Mapping**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VXW5SEWNA1T3PETGH5H.png&w=3840&q=75)

4\. Then select the object category to which you would like to map responses, by clicking on the drop-down under **Choose Object** and choosing from the options.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VV86RH772CAEVDVWJBY.png&w=3840&q=75)

5\. Next, you must choose the exact type of mapping action, by clicking on the drop-down menu under **Choose Action**. There are two types of actions available: creating (creating a new record of that object type), and updating (updating the fields of a specific record of that object type). Not every object will have the two options. For now we’ll click **Create**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VX16GSVYE21K1KGF1DJ.png&w=3840&q=75)

6\. Next, click on **Continue Mapping**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VQ8N491M7GDK8DVY5K1.png&w=3840&q=75)

7\. Now after choosing the object type and mapping action, you must define which exact data gets mapped in which fields of the record, aka create mapping fields. A mapping field has different components. The first component is the survey data type. By default, it’s a question, but you can change this by clicking on the drop-down menu under **Type** and choosing from the options.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VXNBSYR6VWTT80WXMG6.png&w=3840&q=75)

8\. Next, for the chosen data type, you must choose a particular instance from the survey. In this instance, it would be a specific question. You can do this by clicking on the drop-down under **SurveySparrow Field**, and choosing from the options.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VZ7PX8T977JC17WTC85.png&w=3840&q=75)

9\. You also need to define which field of the newly created record is the destination for the data type, by clicking on the drop-down menu under **HubSpot Field**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VZKE8RJH7GMWT88APGY.png&w=3840&q=75)

_**Note:**_ _For some types of objects, like_ _**Calls**_ _, the first mapping will have a preset HubSpot field, which cannot be changed. The field will vary as per the object (eg:_ _**Call Title**_ _would be the field for_ _**Calls**_ _). So you would also have to create additional mapping fields in order to proceed._

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ4VYKWQR87QGJM6XTN019.png&w=3840&q=75)

_**Note:**_ _During the_ _**Configuration**_ _section, if you chose_ _**Update**_ _as the action, the first mapping will also have a preset HubSpot field that can’t be changed. But in this case, it is always going to be_ _**Record ID**_ _. Once again, you must create additional mapping fields to proceed._

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5P13J4EF167F04SGZX44.png&w=3840&q=75)

10\. If the data type has a null value (eg: in this case, a question that goes unanswered), you can add a default value to be filled instead.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5NMEC4QTTPEXJH5X1306.png&w=3840&q=75)

11\. To create additional mappings, click on **New mapping field**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5ND32JXJHMD8AS7J71T6.png&w=3840&q=75)

12\. Once you’ve added the mapping fields, and are ready to save it, click on **Save Mapping**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5NHNXQNPSRWN1F5METS2.png&w=3840&q=75)

13\. Enter a name for the mapping and click **Save Mapping**. Just as described before, you will be taken to a section where you can see both triggers and mappings. You can edit, delete, pause existing mappings and create new mappings.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5NH1QPSKWWPAV3EMHFXT.png&w=3840&q=75)

14\. Just as described before, you will be taken to a section where you can see both triggers and mappings. You can edit, delete or pause existing mappings and create new mappings.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZ5NSJJS0JYXSYQRZEQ4PA.png&w=3840&q=75)

As and when the user completes the survey, the responses will get mapped to the corresponding HubSpot fields.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01K6AERQ8769FJX7REJ8QB930T.png&w=3840&q=75)

_Note: Ensure you add surveysparrow.com to your_ _**Additional site domains**_ _on HubSpot_

## **Creating automated survey triggers** Copy

_**Note:**_ _When it comes to triggers that activate based on updating an object, the native integration only supports a limited number of objects and events per object (see list below)._

| Object name | Update events |
| --- | --- |
| Contact | Lifecycle stage changed |
| Deal | Deal stage changed; Pipeline changed |
| Company | NIL |
| Ticket | NIL |
| Product | NIL |
| Call | NIL |
| Note | NIL |
| Meeting | NIL |
| Lead | NIL |
| Order | NIL |
| Task | NIL |

_But SurveySparrow also offers a workflows app in the HubSpot marketplace that lets you create triggers for a wider range of objects and events (both creation and updating based). To learn more, read_ [_this article_](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/en/articles/4387285731-installing-the-surveysparrow-workflows-app-for-hubspot/) _._

1\. Open/create a survey, then click on the **Integrate** tab.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZS6KMEQJD90C9292ZAD.png&w=3840&q=75)

2\. Search for HubSpot using the search box, then click on the toggle.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZYVC48Y8EW2WVY32TXC.png&w=3840&q=75)

3\. Inside the HubSpot integration window, click on **Trigger**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZXHR3FPBCNG3SX46KGG.png&w=3840&q=75)

4\. To create a trigger, you need to define the event that sets it off - which consists of an object in HubSpot (calls, contacts, etc) and an action that happens to the object (a new record is created or an existing record is updated). Click on the respective drop-down menus under **Choose Object** and **Choose Action** and select the object and actions.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZV385HASDT7PRPZQQJS.png&w=3840&q=75)

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZV55MC4NFD9JKH7BV86.png&w=3840&q=75)

_**Note:**_ _Some objects will only have one action available_.

5\. Click on **Continue**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZW4830JKZC6Z84RZMQR.png&w=3840&q=75)

6\. Next, we proceed to the Trigger Conditions section. Here we must decide the conditions that the selected object must satisfy in order to trigger the event. You can choose to have all the conditions obeyed at once or any one obeyed. To do this click on **all** and choose from the drop-down.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZN1WENHRW1CT2S4W687.png&w=3840&q=75)

7\. Next, you can start creating the conditions by clicking on **Add Condition**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZMXHSR81W8BRS16K64S.png&w=3840&q=75)

8\. The first component of a condition is a property of an object (eg: for Deals, it would be Deal Stage, Deal Type). Select one from the drop-down menu under **Choose Field** or use the search box.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZVVZD9Y9AT2J0X9VB2X.png&w=3840&q=75)

9.  Next, you must choose a data operator for the property which will be used for comparison against the user-defined value . Choose an option from the drop-down menu under **Choose Data Type**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZBZWEC6T8565VEJR6R739.png&w=3840&q=75)

10\. Next, you must define a value. Type it in and click **Save**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBCFXZNXSRRC4K3BDZ6A.png&w=3840&q=75)

_**Note:**_ _In some properties, there might be pre-set values that you can choose, instead of having to type one. This will vary based on the type of property. For example, in date type properties, you must choose a date from a calendar._

11\. To add more conditions, click on **Add Condition**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBCAPYQZ8CZGTCV9JAF4.png&w=3840&q=75)

12\. Next, choose which variables from HubSpot to pass to the survey, by clicking on the drop-down menu under **Choose Fields**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBBB23Z5BDCJ1P78NNPT.png&w=3840&q=75)

13\. Next, select the share channel via which you want to distribute the survey. Start by clicking on the drop-down menu under **Choose Share Type**. Then click on the drop-down under Choose Recipient to select which exact contact property to use (from HubSpot), and then the drop-down under **Choose Share Channel** to choose an existing share of the selected type to use (from SurveySparrow).

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBCV5GYQD1QDT0VPGSDZ.png&w=3840&q=75)![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBA9TDNR4STEB3ZDFM4T.png&w=3840&q=75)![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBD18F15XR6V6HF9G4MG.png&w=3840&q=75)

_**Note:**_ _If there aren’t any shares created for the selected share type, you have the option to create one right within the setup, by clicking on the_ _**New Share**_ _option._

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBB9BBXAJW30GRQENF49.png&w=3840&q=75)

14\. Once you’re satisfied with the trigger, click on **Save Trigger**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEBCWR6YRJ3BRYCKD3HB7.png&w=3840&q=75)

15\. After the trigger is created, you will head to a section where you’ll get to view all the triggers and mappings you’ve created. You can pause the trigger, by clicking on the green toggle.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEB5TF1J79VF3JDT6G0T7.png&w=3840&q=75)

16\. If you’d like to edit the trigger, click on the trigger’s card. It will expand. Then click on **Edit Trigger**.

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZEB67888HS3M5BYW4S9S8.png&w=3840&q=75)

![Image](https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.cdn.sparrowdesk.com%2Fhelpdesk-application%2Fproduction%2Fdc7aa731-6809-4a0c-bb23-b69d172c8781%2Fknowledge-base%2F01KKTZGFBB5QA6Y2DC8YKPG748.png&w=3840&q=75)

17\. To delete the trigger, click on the vertical three-dot icon to the right of the trigger card. A menu appears, with the options to edit and delete triggers. Click on **Delete**.

**Troubleshooting**: HubSpot contact mapping fails with 409 Conflict (Contact already exists)

If your HubSpot mapping is set to Create Contact, HubSpot will return a 409 Conflict when the email already exists in HubSpot. In this case, SurveySparrow will not update the existing contact.

How to fix it (update existing contacts instead of creating new ones)

1\. In your survey’s HubSpot integration, go to Mapping.

2\. Under Choose Object, select Contacts.

3\. Under Choose Action, select Update (instead of Create).

4\. In the mapping fields, the first field will be Record ID (this is mandatory for updates and cannot be changed). Map Record ID to a variable/property that contains the HubSpot Contact Record ID.

5\. Add additional mapping fields for the HubSpot properties you want to update (e.g., phone, lifecycle stage, custom properties), then Save Mapping.

Important: Record ID is required for Update

Update mappings work only when the HubSpot Record ID is available in the survey response. If you are sharing the survey directly from SurveySparrow (link/email share from SurveySparrow), the HubSpot Record ID is typically not available, so the update will fail.

Recommended setup to capture Record ID

Trigger the survey from HubSpot using SurveySparrow’s HubSpot Trigger and enable passing HubSpot fields/variables to the survey. Make sure you pass the Contact Record ID and map it to Record ID in the Update mapping.

Note: If you don’t see the latest Trigger UI (e.g., Choose Object is missing or Continue is disabled), reconnect HubSpot from Settings → Apps and Integrations to access the revamped integration experience.
